THEVALKYRIE-BLESS.title: Bless
THEVALKYRIE-BLESS.description:
Blessing improves numerical [purple]Enchantments[/purple] by [blue]1[/blue], and may stack.

If not specified, Blessing an unenchanted card gives it one of the following enchantments at random: [purple]Sharp 3[/purple] (extra damage),
[purple]Nimble/Adroit 2[/purple] (extra [gold]Block[/gold]),
[purple]Flay 1[/purple] (applies [gold]Gash[/gold]),
or [purple]Aegis 1[/purple] (temporary [gold]Armor[/gold]).
